instruction: Complete the task using command-line or batch-capable tools from Altium Designer, OrCAD Capture, or OpenSCAD. The neutral PCB package `hsd_fpga.ipc2581` and `drawing_config_request.json` are on the desktop. Export via-usage reports. Requirements: - Write `via_usage_by_net.csv`, `via_usage_by_layer.csv`, and `drawing_config.json`. - The reports must count the same vias using net and layer perspectives. Use headers `Net,ViaCount` and `FromLayer,ToLayer,ViaCount`; `drawing_config.json` must contain `reports`, `source_board`, and `units`. [Software] On this machine, the available entry points are OrCAD Capture at `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe`, Altium Designer at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE`, and OpenSCAD at `C:\Program Files\OpenSCAD\openscad.exe`.
